title: The Term Structure of Interest Rates: Spot, Par, and Forward Curves
overview: Spot, par, and forward curves are different representations of the same term structure of interest rates.
example: Draw the promised cash-flow timeline, choose the relevant rates, and identify which risk changes the price.

modules.title: The Term Structure of Interest Rates: Spot, Par, and Forward Curves
modules.explanation: The term structure represents rates across maturities. Spot rates discount single dated cash flows, par rates set coupon bonds at par, and forward rates are future borrowing rates implied by today's spot curve under no arbitrage.
steps: Match each cash flow to its maturity-specific spot rate.
Bootstrap missing spot rates from observable bond prices when required.
Derive par or forward rates and verify that equivalent cash-flow strategies have equal value.

lesson: The term structure represents rates across maturities. Spot rates discount single dated cash flows, par rates set coupon bonds at par, and forward rates are future borrowing rates implied by today's spot curve under no arbitrage.

Fixed-income analysis begins with promised and contingent cash flows, then applies rates appropriate for timing and risk. Price sensitivity also depends on how the curve moves and whether the issuer or borrower can change the cash-flow schedule.
